attempts.sql: WITH sql_db AS (SELECT symbol_id, file_id, qualname FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND name = 'SQLDatabase' AND kind = 'class'), sql_db_methods AS (SELECT s.name FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS s JOIN sql_db AS d ON s.file_id = d.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname = d.qualname || '.' || s.name), connector_classes AS (SELECT DISTINCT cs.symbol_id, cs.qualname, cs.file_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN sql_db AS d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS cs ON cb.class_symbol_id = cs.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f ON cs.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE) SELECT DISTINCT cc.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM connector_classes AS cc JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = cc.file_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.qualname = cc.qualname || '.' || m.name WHERE substr(m.name, 1, 1) <> '_' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sql_db_methods AS sm WHERE sm.name = m.name) ORDER BY cc.symbol_id, m.name;

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This lists each connector class that directly subclasses SQLDatabase and is not in a test file, together with the public methods defined in that connector class body but not defined by SQLDatabase itself. It uses class base relationships, symbol names and qualified names, and the test-file flag, returning distinct class symbol and method name pairs.
sql: WITH sql_db AS (SELECT symbol_id, file_id, qualname FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND name = 'SQLDatabase' AND kind = 'class'), sql_db_methods AS (SELECT s.name FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS s JOIN sql_db AS d ON s.file_id = d.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname = d.qualname || '.' || s.name), connector_classes AS (SELECT DISTINCT cs.symbol_id, cs.qualname, cs.file_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN sql_db AS d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS cs ON cb.class_symbol_id = cs.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f ON cs.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE) SELECT DISTINCT cc.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM connector_classes AS cc JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = cc.file_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.qualname = cc.qualname || '.' || m.name WHERE substr(m.name, 1, 1) <> '_' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sql_db_methods AS sm WHERE sm.name = m.name) ORDER BY cc.symbol_id, m.name;
